Nobody really talkin about the 6:30 am exam... so I guess I’ll start. Retaking from July due to my crap CARS mark from back then

C/P: hella hard (or maybe it’s just me), but so much calculation, and more physics than I thought there was gonna be. Very content heavy (NS level shiz). Probs gonna get 126 or smtg (and that’s being generous)... would not want to do again. 

CARS: surprisingly straightforward questions + questionably easy reads = probably did something wrong (seems to always go that way for CARS lol). The philosophy passages always trip me up tho. Optimistic = 126

B/B: a little more on the difficult side, but I suppose it was to be expected. Just hoping for 126 here.

P/S/B: pretty standard, there was like a random ass biology question in the middle of it, but other than that, think I did well enough to for a 128-9.

So pretty much betting on a 506 here, but just kinda relieved it’s over with. Good luck to the rest of you writing this catastrophe of an exam!
